artworks.title: The Execution of Breaking on the Rack
artworks.artist: William Blake after John Gabriel Stedman
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on wove paper mounted on laid paper

artworks.title: John Caspar Lavater
artworks.description: The image shows a head-and-shoulders profile portrait of a man facing left. His posture is upright, and his head is slightly turned to the left, emphasizing the side of his face. The man has distinct facial features, with a prominent nose and pronounced chin. His hair is wavy and pulled back, partially covered by a cap that fits snugly to his head. He is wearing a coat over a collared shirt with a cravat or scarf tied around his neck. There are no visible pieces of jewelry, and he holds no objects. The background consists of a subtle circular pattern, rendered in a lighter shade to highlight the subject. The entire setting appears to be a stylized illustration, possibly etching, rather than a photograph.

artworks.title: Canto I, Verse 29
artworks.artist: William Blake after Mary Ann Flaxman
artworks.description: In the image, there are two people, a man and a woman, in an outdoor setting. The woman stands to the left, holding a basket of flowers. She wears a long gown and has long hair. The man is seated in a wooden chair to the right, holding a scroll. A large tree and some flowering plants surround them. The scene is intricately detailed in line-based engraving style.

artworks.title: Canto II, Verse 471
artworks.artist: William Blake after Mary Ann Flaxman
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a kneeling position with her elbows resting on a draped surface. She has dark hair, a headband, and wears a long gown. Next to her is a chair, and a lit lamp or candle stands to her right. The background has heavy curtains and textured walls and floors.

artworks.title: Canto III, Verse 201
artworks.artist: William Blake after Mary Ann Flaxman
artworks.description: The image shows the silhouette of a woman from the back, standing with her hands clasped in front. She has a bun hairstyle with a headband and wears a long dress with a high collar. There are intricate carvings or drawings on a rock surface featuring mythical figures. The setting seems to be inside a cave or dimly lit chamber based on the textured background.

artworks.title: Canto V, Verse 43
artworks.artist: William Blake after Mary Ann Flaxman
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person resting under a looming figure. The scene shows an individual seated and draped in flowing garments, in what appears to be a bed or reclined setting. A large, ghostly figure dominates from the left side, with swirling lines creating a mysterious aura. The spectral figure has an ornate design atop, where the ethereal form meets swirling clouds or fabric. The background is dark, with a thick curtain hanging to the right.

artworks.title: Canto VI, Verse 294
artworks.artist: William Blake after Mary Ann Flaxman
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with multiple figures. It depicts a gathering of figures within an ornate architectural setting. In the foreground are two figures: one in a bear-skin garment and the other in a flowing dress. Behind them, more figures engage in conversation. The background features large archways, suggesting a grand hall. The linework captures fabric and surface textures, enhancing the detailing of the space and its occupants.

artworks.title: Sketch of a Shipwreck
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a shipwreck scene. The image shows a group of figures amidst waves and wreckage. The main focus is a shipwreck with broken masts in the background. Some figures cling to the ship remnants, while others are tossed around by waves. One figure, prominently centered, displays a gesture of despair or urgency. The image conveys the chaotic nature of a shipwreck through swirling lines representing water movement and the desperate situation. Detailed line work and shading create depth and drama similar to traditional engraving techniques. The title 'Sketch of a Shipwreck after Romney' suggests the piece is inspired by the style of artist George Romney.

artworks.title: Reverend Robert Hawker, D.D.
artworks.description: The image displays a man seated in a dignified position. He has a rounded face with prominent features, short hair, and is wearing formal clerical attire. He holds an open book in his left hand and the background is a plain, dark, textured wall.

artworks.title: Wilson Lowry
artworks.description: The image shows a head and shoulders portrait of Wilson Lowry. He is depicted in a three-quarter view looking slightly to his left, with distinct facial features including a strong jawline, well-defined cheekbones, and a slightly furrowed brow. His dark, curly hair is cut short. He is dressed in a high-collared shirt or cravat and possibly a coat. The plain background emphasizes his face. There are no visible accessories or objects, and an engraving with his name and other text is included in the surrounding area.

artworks.title: Bookplate of Dominicus Frauenfelder
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in yellow, green, black, and brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a heraldic shield with botanical motifs. The image features a shield divided into two contrasting halves, each featuring an abstract branching coral-like design. The left side of the shield has a golden background with black designs, while the right side is predominantly black with a golden design. Surrounding the shield are ornamental plants and flowers rendered in shades of green and muted colors. The letters "D" and "F" are prominently placed, each on either side of the shield. The simplistic style of the drawing suggests a focus on symbolic representation and heraldic tradition.

artworks.title: The Morning Amusements of her Royal Highness
artworks.description: The image shows a group of six individuals, including both adults and children, gathered in a domestic setting. The individuals are engaging in various activities. One adult woman on the left is sitting in profile, wearing a dress with a full skirt and a lace apron, and a cap. She appears to be instructing two young girls seated next to her on the floor, both wearing dresses with lace detailing and caps, with one child holding an open book. Another adult woman is standing at the center, holding a young child, wrapping them in fabric. She is also wearing a dress with lace and a cap. To the right, another woman is seated, facing forward, leaning slightly on a chair, with elaborate hair and earrings visible; she holds a partially visible piece of cloth. Next to her, behind the chair she leans on, stands another adult wearing a cap and cloak, observing the scene. The background consists of intricately designed panels or wallpaper, and a decorative wall sconce is visible.

artworks.title: Thenot and Colinet
artworks.description: The image shows two figures with sheep in a pastoral setting. The figures are standing in a landscape with sheep around them. One figure holds a staff and leans on a tree, while the other stands with a gesture. The background shows a bright area hinting at either a sunrise or sunset over distant hills. The scene is depicted in a style resembling classic woodcut illustrations in black and white.

artworks.title: Thenot Remonstrates with Colinet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an open book with figures in a landscape setting. The central image is a monochromatic drawing depicting a scene with an open book in the center, surrounded by two figures. One figure stands on each side, holding up their arms. The background features a landscape including hills and a tree on the right. The use of line and shading creates a dramatic scene, focusing the viewer's attention on the interaction between the figures and the book. The composition is bordered by a golden rectangle.

artworks.title: Thenot under Fruit Tree
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a nighttime landscape scene. It includes a full moon in the sky partially covered by clouds. Two figures are sitting under a tree while a flock of sheep grazes nearby. There is a mountainous backdrop and a small dwelling in the distance. The drawing uses detailed line work and high contrast between light and dark areas to convey the stillness of the nighttime environment.

artworks.title: Thenot Remonstrates with Colinet, Lightfoot in Background
artworks.description: The image is a small, rectangular illustration placed centrally on a blank page. The horizon line is situated near the middle of the illustration, with two figures standing on either side of a sheep. There is a faint outline of trees or buildings in the distance. The style appears to be a woodcut or engraving, with crisp lines and high contrast between black and white. The entire page has a monochromatic color palette with the illustration rendered in black against the beige tone of the paper.

artworks.title: Colinet Departs in Sorrow
artworks.description: The image features a small black and white illustration on a light brown page. The scene shows two figures interacting, with one raising their arms. A tree with a twisty trunk is to the right, and sheep are gathered in the background. The landscape slopes gently upward, possibly indicating a horizon line. The style uses linear brushstrokes and crosshatching for texture and shadow, creating depth. The color palette is monochrome with black ink on light paper.

artworks.title: Blasted Tree and Flattened Crops
artworks.description: The image shows a small, black and white engraving of a landscape view from a lower vantage point. There is a gnarled tree in the foreground, with detailed bark textures. Beyond the tree are wavy lines indicating hills or fields. The horizon is near the upper third, with a crescent moon against a dark sky filled with subtle lines for depth and texture. The color palette is monochromatic, using black, white, and gray for contrast. The image is framed by a plain margin.

artworks.title: Shepherd Chases away Wolf
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene from a slightly elevated point of view looking into a valley. The horizon line is at the top edge of the drawing with hills or mountains in the distance. There is a structure among trees, depicted with detailed lines. The style is similar to a woodcut or engraving with stark black and white contrasts, cross-hatching, and line work for depth. The trees have swirling lines and the buildings are more structured. The color palette is black ink on a beige page for tonal contrast.

artworks.title: 'Sabrina's silvery flood'
artworks.description: The image shows a black ink illustration on a beige backdrop. A landscape is depicted with a river meandering through the scene. The horizon is high, showing trees and the sky with horizontal lines. A cottage sits on the right among trees, defined by shadows and details created with strokes. The artwork is in black and white with bold, textured strokes.

artworks.title: Colinet's Journey
artworks.description: This is a small black-and-white print on a larger sheet of tan paper. The small print shows undulating hills under a thin strip of light sky. A path winds through bushes and shrubs around the hills, and there is a person standing on it. The person is on the left side of the print next to a small, pointed structure with "LXII" engraved on its side. The person holds a long stick and wears a hat and a long, flowing garment.

artworks.title: 'A rolling stone is ever bare of moss'
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person pulling a large barrel or container across a path in front of a building. It is situated in the center of a larger beige-colored page. The drawing depicts an outdoor environment with a pathway bordered by a large building in the background, an older style with visible details such as windows and a door. A tree appears prominently on the right side of the frame, and the sky above is marked with lines suggesting a textured or sky-filled background. The drawing emphasizes strong contrasts between the dark ink and the lighter background.

artworks.title: Colinet Resting by Night
artworks.description: The image features a small, black and white print at the center of a tan, textured paper. The scene shows a nighttime landscape with a crescent moon in the sky and a figure resting next to a tree. The print uses woodcut lines to depict texture and shadows, with the background suggesting rolling terrain. The bold shadows and strokes create a dramatic monochromatic palette, highlighting the contrast between light and dark. The compact size of the print emphasizes its details against the paper's expanse.

artworks.title: Colinet Mocked by Two Boys
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a forest with figures and trees. The central image is crafted in black and white against a plain background, depicting three figures within a wooded landscape. The figures stand among large, darkly-shaded trees, giving the appearance of a dense forest. The figures are positioned to interact with each other or the environment, creating a narrative element in the artwork. The intricate details of shading suggest depth and complexity, adding a sense of mystery or drama to the scene. Overall, the artwork conveys a classical style, reminiscent of traditional etchings that emphasize strong contrast and fine detail.
